The '''Jospro sector''' was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Jospro included [[Cardooine/Legends|Cardooine]], [[Engira]], [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]], [[Waskiro/Legends|Waskiro]], and [[Dar'Or]]. [[Wilek Nereus]] served in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] at some point prior to his appointment at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].

Jospro sector planets were home to the [[ix dbukrii]], a small parasite which, when introduced into [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] brains, created permanent scarring of the neocortex, creating symptoms similar to advanced senility.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]], [[Crondre/Legends|Crondre]], [[Azbrian]], and [[Douglas III]] in the Jospro Sector. Kiffex is in the [[Kiffex system/Legends|Azurbani system]] as part of the [[Kiffu sector/Legends|Kiffu sector]]; Douglas III is in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]; Chrondre is in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]; Azbrian is in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].
